safetyMessage: Use public settings shortcuts and customer-safe options first. Advanced or untested features must show clear labels and must stay systemless.
changelog: Added Customer Customization Center as the launcher activity.
Added customer toggles for wallpaper, icons, fonts, sounds, System UI, Settings UI, OPlus UX, battery, notifications, OTA guard, Rootd systemless mode, and LSPosed preview.
Added public system settings shortcuts and customer support report export.
Expanded package visibility metadata for OPPO, OnePlus, realme, Android, SystemUI, Settings, Launcher, OPlus, OTA, and wallpaper targets.
Kept direct system partition writes blocked and advanced overlay work systemless-only.
